import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

# Create a bar plot to show survival rate by passenger class
sns.barplot(x='pclass', y='survived', hue='sex', data=data, ci=None, palette='pastel')

# Add labels and title
plt.title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Gender on the Titanic')
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class')
plt.ylabel('Survival Rate')
plt.legend(title='Gender')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
